episodeTitle.en: How marketplaces win: Liquidity, growth levers, quality, more | Benjamin Lauzier (Lyft, Thumbtack)
episodeTitle.zh: 市场平台如何取胜：流动性、增长杠杆、质量等 | 本杰明·劳齐尔（Lyft、Thumbtack）

guestBioOfficial.en: Benjamin Lauzier has been building and scaling marketplaces for almost 15 years. He was the VP of product and growth at Thumbtack, where he rebuilt the product team and Thumbtack’s growth levers, re-architected their revenue model, and helped double the company’s growth within three years. Prior to Thumbtack, Ben was at Lyft for six years, where he led the supply side of the product organization to a point where 1% of U.S. workers were driving for Lyft every month. Currently, he advises marketplace teams and founders, teaches a Reforge course on marketplace growth, and has recently launched a health tech company called Nurra, which connects users with care advocates to navigate the health-care system. In our conversation, we cover: • What defines a marketplace business
guestBioOfficial.zh:
班杰明·劳齐尔（Benjamin Lauzier）过去近15年一直致力于搭建和扩展电商平台。他曾在Thumbtack担任产品与增长副总裁，期间重组了产品团队和增长引擎，重新设计了公司的营收模式，并在三年内助力公司增长率翻倍。在加入Thumbtack之前，班杰明曾在Lyft工作六年，期间他将该公司的供应侧产品部门打造成美国每月有1%劳动者为Lyft平台司机的规模。目前，他为多个电商团队和创始人提供咨询服务，教授Reforge平台关于电商增长的课程，并于近期创立了健康科技公司Nurra，该公司致力于帮助用户与医疗顾问对接，助力其在医疗体系中高效寻医问药。在本次对谈中，我们将探讨：
• 何为电商平台业务

title.en: How marketplaces win: Liquidity, growth levers, quality, more | Benjamin Lauzier (Lyft, Thumbtack)
title.zh: 市场平台如何取胜：流动性、增长杠杆、质量等 | 本杰明·劳齐尔（Lyft、Thumbtack）

summary.en: Ben goes deep on building and scaling marketplaces: what to focus on pre-product-market fit, which side to prioritize, how to track liquidity, and what causes most marketplaces to fail. He advocates providing guardrails and empowering supply rather than micromanaging from an ivory tower, plus clever supply-side growth tactics. The conversation also contrasts the European and U.S. product markets and what European companies should change.
summary.zh: Ben 深入探讨了构建和扩展双边市场：产品市场匹配前要关注什么、优先哪一侧、如何追踪流动性，以及大多数市场失败的原因。他主张提供护栏、赋能供给侧，而非坐在象牙塔里微观管理，并分享巧妙的供给侧增长策略。对话还对比了欧洲与美国产品市场，以及欧洲公司应做出哪些改变。
